0022600209.text: The Phoenix Suns (3-5, 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 4 games back) host the San Antonio Spurs (7-2, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West), with Phoenix on a two-game winning streak and San Antonio riding a seven-game one. Phoenix is 3-2 at home and 0-3 on the road, while San Antonio is 3-0 on the road. Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2-2 series in 2025-26, and their last meeting was on March 19, 2026 in San Antonio, where Phoenix lost 101-100.
